title: Writing for Government and the Public Sector
description: Introduction to essential skills of writing effectively for government and public sector organizations. Develops skills in focusing on a purpose, writing for different audiences, structuring information effectively and writing clear, concise and correct English. Taught in a computer lab and features extensive practice in writing briefing notes, memos, correspondence and reports.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ENSH 304, ADMN 316, ENGL 302.
This is a Professional Communication course.
